_note_fetch: FETCH clauses (ADR-0032 parametric tier; hypergeometric-fetch-closure WP3) — the tutor/recycle PREDICATE a boolean Function Tag can't carry, so the gamble closure never parses card text at runtime OR build time. Verified against engine card text (all_card_data / EN_Card_Data.csv), never memory; probe-unreachable (a search select's target constraints aren't measured) -> override-only, like the heal gates. Fields: target = basic_energy | basic_pokemon | pokemon | mega | energy(incl Special) | evolution; zone = deck (whole-deck search) | discard (recycle, visible pool); energy_type = EnergyType code the fetch is type-LOCKED to (Fighting {F}=6), absent = any; no_rule_box = true for a fetch that excludes ex/Mega/V (Poke Pad); hp_max = an HP ceiling on the target (Poffin <=70); no_ability = true for an ability-less-only target (Salvatore); dest = deck (default) | bench (Poffin) | in_play (Salvatore rush-evolve). This is the tier `doctrine_fetch._FETCH_FILTERS` MIGRATED onto (bench_fill/tutor_mega/tutor_pokemon/rush_evolve). 1119 Energy Search: a Basic Energy -> deck. 1100 Energy Search Pro (ACE SPEC): any number of different-type Basic Energy -> deck. 1142 Fighting Gong: a Basic {F} Energy OR a Basic {F} Pokemon -> deck (TWO clauses; the {F}-lock the tutor_energy tag can't see). 1097 Night Stretcher: a Pokemon OR a Basic Energy -> discard. 1118 Energy Retrieval: up to 2 Basic Energy -> discard. 1110 Max Rod: up to 5 Pokemon and/or Basic Energy -> discard. 1121 Ultra Ball: a Pokemon -> deck (cost = discard 2). 1152 Poke Pad: a Pokemon WITHOUT a Rule Box -> deck. 1145 Mega Signal: a Mega Evolution Pokemon {ex} -> deck. 1086 Buddy-Buddy Poffin: up to 2 Basic Pokemon with <=70 HP -> bench. 1189 Salvatore: a card with NO Abilities that evolves from one of your Pokemon -> put onto it (in_play). 1225 Hilda: an Evolution Pokemon AND an Energy card (incl Special) -> deck.

_covers._note: Per-CARD clause-set COMPLETENESS verdicts (Issue #300): does this card's clause set cover its WHOLE printed effect? `full` | `partial`, each quoting the leg the clauses carry or miss. Ported from the Issue #269 census's hand-ruled table (tools/apply_seam_coverage.py), which read every verdict off the engine's own card text beside the committed clauses; the cards outside that census's pool were ruled the same way here. This is a per-card fact, not a per-clause one, so it lives beside the clause lists rather than inside them — a card whose clauses are purely probe-MEASURED needs a verdict too, and giving it a numeric override entry to carry one would REPLACE the measurement. Re-stamped into common/card_effects.json under the same key by build_card_effects.py; read by common.snapshot_coverage.partial_clause_cards() and fed to apply_option.fate's `clauses_cover` so a PARTIAL set REFUSES instead of pricing its uncovered leg at 0.

_note_engines: DRAW-ENGINE + ACCEL clauses (ADR-0032 parametric tier; hypergeometric-fetch-closure WP3, the 3-agents' engines). Verified against engine ability/attack text (cg.api all_card_data skills), never memory; abilities are UNPROBEABLE (a Pokemon Ability, conditional) -> override-only. Draw fields: amount = cards drawn to hand; window = cards SEEN (Drakloak digs 2, keeps 1; = amount when absent); condition = a board gate (once_per_turn_ability / pokemon_ko_last_turn / solrock_in_play); rider = a side-effect (shuffle_self_in / other_to_bottom / discard_basic_f_energy / shuffle_both_hands). Accel fields: amount = units the effect ATTACHES; to_hand = units it merely puts in HAND (playable only via the turn's one manual attach — the Attach Budget's separate leg, ADR-0067); source (deck/discard); target (any_pokemon/stage2/benched) + target_type (an EnergyType the RECIPIENT must be); energy (basic) + energy_type (an EnergyType the fetched Energy is locked to); distinct_types = the units this card yields must take DIFFERENT types; condition. 66 Dudunsparce 'Run Away Draw': draw 3, then shuffle itself+attached into deck (dragapult). 120 Drakloak 'Recon Directive': look top 2, take 1, other to bottom (dragapult). 140 Fezandipiti ex 'Flip the Script': if a Pokemon was KO'd during opp's last turn, draw 3 (dragapult). 675 Lunatone 'Lunar Cycle': if Solrock in play, discard a Basic {F} Energy from hand -> draw 3 (mega_lucario). 1080 Unfair Stamp (ACE SPEC): only if a Pokemon was KO'd during opp's last turn; both shuffle hands, you draw 5 / opp draws 2 (mega_lucario, dragapult). 1240 Rosa's Encouragement: if MORE Prizes remaining than opp (prize-behind), attach up to 2 Basic Energy from discard to a Stage 2 (dragapult). 1198 Crispin: fetch 2 diff-type Basic Energy, put 1 to hand and ATTACH the other to any Pokemon (accel side; dragapult) -- deliberately NO fetch clause (a Supporter is slot-dead after a Supporter refresh, so the gamble energy-closure must not count it); the put-1-to-hand half rides the SAME accel clause as `to_hand: 1` + `distinct_types` (issue #137 / ADR-0067 -- the Attach Budget needs the full 2-unit yield that reaches a 2-cost typed attack, and a fetch clause would have silently re-armed the closure this note excludes). 1146 Wondrous Patch (Item): attach a Basic {P} Energy from the DISCARD to a BENCHED {P} Pokemon -- both restrictions carried (target: benched + target_type: 5 recipient, energy_type: 5 source), so it never funds the Active. ATTACK-based accel stays the AttackStat tier (ADR-0064: a card tag would corrupt the burst-budget scan): 678 Aura Jab already carries recoverN=3/{F}/bench; 965 Turbo Flare's deck-source variant is parsed into the same family (recoverSource='deck', card_text._DECK_ACCEL_RE) -- gap CLOSED 2026-07-18.

_note_energy_recur: ENERGY_RECUR clauses (Issue #204) — the discard-reload PREDICATE the boolean `discard_energy_recur` Function Tag can't carry: how many, of what type, on WHAT TRIGGER, and to WHICH targets. The clock (`combat.turns_to_afford` via `discard_recur_fuel(scope='self_arming')`) needs all four to answer "does this reload pay for THIS body's own attack?"; the tag alone answers only "could they refuel at all", which is the fail-OPEN doom-relax caution and stays tag-routed. Probe-unreachable (neither effect resolves on a Trainer probe board) -> override-only, like the heal gates. Fields: amount = the printed cap; energy_type = the EnergyType code the reload is locked to; zone = where it comes FROM; trigger = on_evolve (an Ability firing as the evolution is played — the same hop the clock counts) | on_attack (an attack effect, which needs the body already armed); target = own_type | bench_only (whether the reloading body may take the Energy itself). Verified against engine card text (all_card_data / EN_Card_Data.csv), never memory. 190 Archaludon ex [Ability] Assemble Alloy: 'When you play this Pokemon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokemon during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic {M} Energy cards from your discard pile to your {M} Pokemon in any way you like.' -> on_evolve / own_type (the evolved body IS {M}, so it may take them) -> the clock credits it. 678 Mega Lucario ex Aura Jab (an ATTACK, {F} 130): 'Attach up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokemon in any way you like.' -> on_attack / bench_only (never the attacker) -> the clock does NOT credit it toward that body's own arming.
_note_opp_accel: OPPONENT-SIDE deck-search ACCEL (Issue #257) — an `accel` clause carrying a TRIGGER, so the opponent-facing Threat Clock can credit reach the self-side Attach Budget never looked at (that Budget is Item/Supporter-only by Issue #137's charter, and it is MY turn's primitive). Verified against engine card text (all_card_data / EN_Card_Data.csv), never memory. 648 Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex [Ability] Punk Up: 'When you play this Pokemon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokemon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 5 Basic {D} Energy cards and attach them to your Marnie's Pokemon in any way you like.' -> trigger on_evolve, target own_line (a Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex IS a Marnie's Pokemon), 5 Basic {D} (EnergyType.DARKNESS = 7). The card had NO entry at all in card_functions.json, so it was doubly invisible; it is now tagged energy_accel there too. A pool sweep for 'search your deck ... and attach' found 29 cards: 24 are ATTACKS (which end the turn, so they can never fund another attack — ADR-0064's existing exclusion), and of the 5 Abilities only Punk Up fires on the EVOLVE HOP the clock already counts. The other four (641 X-Boot once-per-turn, 340 Buzzing Boost on-promote, 834 Sinister Surge benched-only, 871 Frilled Generator gated on a hidden Canari play) each need a board-level premise a per-form read cannot carry; see CombatMath._evolve_accel.
